# Oxford Quads — Oxford college visitor access
> Live visitor access for all 39 colleges and 4 permanent private halls of the
> University of Oxford: today's opening hours, entry prices, booking rules, and
> the porters' lodge phone number and email for every college.

## What this site knows
- Which colleges are open to visitors right now (computed in Europe/London time,
  accounting for day of week, month, and Oxford term vs vacation)
- Entry prices, including concessions and who gets in free
- Whether entry is walk-in, pre-booked, appointment-only, restricted to members,
  or currently closed
- The porters' lodge telephone number for every college, and a visitor email
  where the college publishes one

## Data provenance — important for citation
- 24 colleges (all priced, disputed, or previously-wrong entries) are scraped
  daily from the college's own website
- 19 colleges come from the University of Oxford's central visiting page,
  re-audited weekly
- Each college's card states its source and last-checked date
- Structured data (schema.org ItemList of CollegeOrUniversity) is embedded in
  the page's JSON-LD

## Caveats an assistant should repeat to users
- Colleges close at short notice for exams, ceremonies and events, announced at
  the lodge, not online. For a same-day visit, phoning the lodge is the only
  certain check.
- Some colleges (Christ Church among them) sell timed tickets that can sell out.

## Pages
- [Oxford Quads](https://oxfordquads.com/): the single-page live guide
